sentences.text: The wellbore 15/9-F-15 has 69 daily reports, 36 of them flagged as dated before spud.
The first report without a before-spud flag is dated 2008-11-10 and the last report is dated 2018-01-24.
The report span is 3363 days, with 33 active days and 2 campaigns.
The deepest reported measured depth is 4090.0 m, with TVD 3178.0 m at that depth; the Sodir total depth is 4105.0 m.
Total activity time is 1435.48 h; primary lost time is 74.0 h, or 5.16% of activity time.
Possible lost time of 157.0 h (10.94%) is reported separately and is not included in the primary figures.
Section 6 reached total depth at 4090.0 m on 2008-11-28; Sodir lists the entry on 2007-12-24 and the completion of drilling on 2008-12-05.
Plug-and-abandonment work followed, and operations were transferred to F-15 on 2008-12-11; the Sodir status is P&A, and the last report on 2018-01-24 carries no activities.
Campaign 1 runs from 2008-11-10 to 2008-12-11, a span of 32 days with 32 active days and dominant phase drilling.
Campaign 2 is a single day, 2018-01-24, with 1 active day and no operation phase recorded (phase none).
The Sodir completion date of 2008-12-05 is later than the TD date of 2008-11-28 because plug-and-abandonment work after TD falls inside campaign 1.
Section 0 covers 0.25 h of moving activity before the first stated section; its hole size is unknown.
Section 1 is a 36 in hole drilled from 2007-11-19 to 2007-12-22.

It ran from 144.2 m to 226.0 m MD, with TVD 226.0 m at section end, drilling 226.0 m of new hole at an average coded drilling rate of 18.45 m/h (an average over all time coded drilling, not an on-bottom rate of penetration).
Section 2 is a 26 in hole drilled from 2007-12-23 to 2007-12-30.
It ran from 226.0 m to 1378.0 m MD (TVD 1347.0 m), drilling 1152.0 m of new hole at an average coded drilling rate of 20.57 m/h.
Section 3 is a 26 in hole from 2008-09-06 to 2008-09-10 at 1378.0 m MD with no new hole, so no drilling rate is reported; it logged 100.48 h of activity.
Section 4 is a 26 in hole drilled from 2008-09-18 to 2008-09-19.
It ran from 1378.0 m to 1381.0 m MD (TVD 1349.0 m), drilling 3.0 m of new hole at an average coded drilling rate of 0.71 m/h.
Section 5 is a 12.25 in hole drilled from 2008-09-20 to 2008-11-12.
It ran from 1381.0 m to 2536.0 m MD (TVD 2350.0 m), drilling 1155.0 m of new hole at an average coded drilling rate of 10.11 m/h.
Section 6 is an 8.5 in hole drilled from 2008-11-13 to 2008-11-28.
It ran from 2536.0 m to 4090.0 m MD (TVD 3178.0 m), drilling 1554.0 m of new hole at an average coded drilling rate of 8.42 m/h.
Section 7 is a plug-and-abandon section whose hole size is unknown, running from 2008-11-29 to 2018-01-24.
It stays at 4090.0 m MD (TVD 3178.0 m) with no new hole, so no drilling rate is reported; it logged 279.0 h of activity.
Section 1 starts below a casing shoe at 220.6 m and sets no casing; no casing shoe is reported for its end.
Section 2 starts below the same 220.6 m shoe and sets casing with its shoe at 1368.4 m MD.
Sections 3 and 4 start below the 1368.4 m shoe and set no casing.

Section 5 starts below the 1368.4 m shoe and sets casing with its shoe at 2561.8 m MD, whereas the drilling reports record the shoe as found at 2534 m during drill-out (quote: csg shoe found at 2534 m).
Sections 6 and 7 start below the 2534.0 m shoe and set no casing; the tools give no casing size, so none is stated here.
Primary lost time in section 2 is 1.25 h, or 0.7% of that section's activity time.
Primary lost time in section 3 is 4.5 h, or 4.48% of that section's activity time.
Primary lost time in section 5 is 17.5 h, or 4.05% of that section's activity time.
Primary lost time in section 6 is 50.5 h, or 14.08% of that section's activity time, the largest share of any section.
Primary lost time in section 7 is 0.25 h, or 0.09% of that section's activity time.
Sections 1 and 4 carry no primary lost time.
By cause, primary lost time is 49.0 h of well-control interruptions, mainly the circulation losses in section 6.
Other primary causes are 13.25 h of waiting on weather, 5.5 h of drilling wait, 4.25 h of fishing, and 2.0 h of repair.

Possible lost time is reported separately from the primary figures: 93.0 h of other interruptions, 49.25 h of maintenance interruptions, 14.0 h of plug-and-abandon waiting and 0.75 h of interruption waiting, 157.0 h in total.
Possible lost time is largest in section 5 at 71.5 h (16.56% of that section's activity time) and in section 7 at 62.5 h (22.4%).
Possible lost time in section 2 is 7.75 h (4.33%), in section 4 7.0 h (26.42%), in section 6 7.0 h (1.95%), in section 3 1.0 h (1.0%) and in section 1 0.25 h (0.42%).
On 2008-09-07 the operation waited 3.0 h for sea state after the riser was pulled out of the splash zone; this is primary lost time.

sentences.text: On 2008-09-20 the drill string came apart at the drilling pup joint; the report records that the string was found screwed out underneath the pup joint, and the fishing operation took 4.25 h of primary time in section 5.
On 2008-11-11 waiting on weather for the derrick inspection began; the weather waits total 13.25 h of primary lost time in section 5.

sentences.text: From 2008-11-14 mud losses in the Ty formation required 49.0 h of primary well-control time in section 6; the report states 'Total loss since starting to loose mud on this section was approx 19 m3.'
On 2008-11-22 a BX elevator latching fault was repaired in 0.5 h of primary time, and leaving the drill floor for CO monitoring took 1.0 h of primary wait.

On 2008-11-24 a flow check showed a trip-tank gain; the well was shut in and monitored for 2.5 h, and the report concludes conclusion is supercharged formation (quote: conclusion is supercharged formation).
From 2008-11-29 the well was plugged and abandoned; section 7 logged 279.0 h of activity, and casing was cut and pulled from 2008-12-07.
On 2008-12-11 drilling out of the cement plugs ended with a kick-off and the report records the transfer, quoted as Operations transferred to F-15.
The last report, on 2018-01-24, has no activities and is the only record in campaign 2.
Plan weather windows for derrick inspection and riser handling: the weather waits totalled 13.25 h of primary time and the sea-state waits 3.0 h.

Prove the drilling control system (ZMS and VICIS) before spud and carry spares: section 4 control-related waits were 7.0 h of possible time, and other interruptions across the well reached 93.0 h of possible time.
Agree a loss-control plan before entering the Ty formation: the 49.0 h of primary well-control time arose there, so LCM volume and mud-weight steps should be fixed in advance.
Verify make-up and torque of pup joints and drill pipe before running in the drilling-out section that starts at 1381.0 m: the string screwed out under a pup joint and fishing took 4.25 h.
Reconcile casing shoe depths before drill-out: the tools give 2561.8 m for the casing shoe set in section 5, while the reports record the shoe at 2534 m.
Record why the Sodir completion date (2008-12-05) differs from the last report date (2018-01-24): plug-and-abandon and kick-off activity ran after TD, and the 2018 record has no activities.

row.comments: Entered the water splash zone. To much movement, pulled HPDR out of the water.
Waited for sea to calm down to be able to run in with HPDR.

Continued RIH with 17½" drilling BHA on 5½" DP from 127m to 695m. The top 5½" DP jnt was bent when hit by TDS.  Area was barried off. No dropped object.

***Operations transferred to F-99***
Circulated on well while working on problem with VICIS.
1RIH with 5 1/2" DP. Tagged fish at 41,6 m MD indicating that drillstring had fallen to the bottom of the well.
Attempted to screw into DP coupling at 41,6 m MD - negative. Meanwhile traced fishing equipment.
Removed auto slips from rotary. Pulled DP to different positions relative to wellcenter in attempt to enter threads in drillstring. Entered DP thread successfully. Meanwhile traced fishing equipment.
Made up DP coupling at 41,6 m MD with topdrive. Increased torque in increments of 5 kNm to a total of 45 kNm. String broke free at 45 kNm.

Attempted to work string free. Not able to come down - string at TD. Attempted to come up - functioned jar twice. Attempted to work string free by applying torque up to 40 kNm and overpull of 40 MT. Made way from 1381 m to 1376 m MD. Attempted to pump - hole still packed off. Bled off 27 bar pressure trapped on standpipe and heard loud roarring sound. Lost string weight - went to just above block weight. POOH with 5 1/2" DP and found string screwed out underneath 6 m drilling pup joint. Laid out pup joint - found no damage on threads.
Discussed fishing alternatives and way forward.
Held pre-job meeting for attempting to screw into drillpipe.
Troubleshot problems with ZMS / control system.

WOW for derrick inspection. 

Meanwhile changed out bumper bar on aft PRS using parts from fwd PRS. Fixed broken electrical connection on aft PRS. Removed scaffolding from rig floor. Injected slop into F-14. Performed remaining pressure test on kill and choke manifolds. Modified hooks for lifting bridle. Changed o-rings on leaking coomey unit. Installed flush joint elevator on PRS and function tested same.
Drilled out shoe track, 9 5/8" csg shoe found at 2534 m. Parameters: Flow 1700 lpm / SPP 198-210 bar / String RPM 10 / TQ 5-8 kNm. MUD weight 1.44 SG.

Staged up pumps to establish loss free rate. Meanwhile continued adding LCM chemicals to active and prepared 150 kg/m3 LCM pill in pit according contingency plan. Monitored losses while pumping and reciprocating pipe, Flow 440 lpm / SPP 25 bar / String RPM 10 / TQ 9-10 kNm. Average loss rate 1000 ltrs/hr.

Circulated and reciprocated pipe from 2670 m to 2641 m , Flow 1000 lpm / SPP 66 bar / String RPM 5 / TQ 5-7 kNm. Prepared for reducing mud weight down to 1.30 SG. Total loss since starting to loose mud on this section was approx 19 m3.
Left drill floor due to exhaust (CO levels @ 60 ppm), monitor area until clear reading on sensors.
Changed out BX elevators due to latching problem, back up set would not work, installed original elevator & investigated problem with latch.

Flow checked well, observed rapid increase to Trip Tank, shut in well on upper rams, monitored pressure built up SIDP 0bar (float installed), SICP 6,7 bars.
11:50 bled off approx 1m³ from well and closed in, SICP 5,0 bar - no pressure built up.
12:18 bled off additional 2.75 m³ from well and closed in, SICP 3,2 bars - no pressure built up.
As no pressure built up to original SICP was observed, conclusion is supercharged formation. Continued to bleed off from well, observed decreasing trend in flow back and decided to open BOP. Total volume bled back from well: 4½ m³.
Rigged up to RIH with 3½'' Drill pipe.

Filled pipe pumping at 500 lpm. Obtained pump benchmark for cutting casing 500 lpm / SPP 59 bar, stopped pumps. Started rotation with 120 rpm. Started circulation at 500 lpm. Observer torque bulidingup to 5-11 kNm indicating effective cutting. Noticed small shock in derrick after 2,5 min of cutting indicating successful cut. Stopped rotation. Increased pump rate to 900 lpm / 55 bar - good indication. Picked up 2,5 m above cut. Came down while pumping at 400 lpm, observed sudden pressure drop as prescribed when passing cut at 1422 m MD. Stopped pumping. Marked pipe and tagged top of cut casing 0,25 m below (cut gap).

Drilled cement below 20" shoe and new formation from 1368 m to 1381 m MD. Encountered soft cement underneath shoe. Initiated kick-off. Drilling parameters : 4000 lpm / SPP 190 bar / ECD 1,43-1,44 / 1-2 MT WOB / 60 RPM / Torque 6-10 kNm.

****Operations transferred to F-15****
